- csvs with p50/p90/p95/p99 and tokens/sec for batch sizes 1/2/4/8
- list of any >3x-median outliers with anonymized prompt text
- exact env & hashes: bench_client sha, runtime sha, tokenizer sha, cuda/cuDNN versions, quant flags, batcher config, seeds.txt

lee-eng: plan: smoke run today (10m) to validate exporters, full sweep Tue 09:00 UTC on A100 pool. will capture gpu mem timeline and batch occupancy. we'll also provide a 1-page methodology brief explaining variance sources and mitigation.
